Real Mars-weight vehicle on natural dunes, so field is correct.

Section 10 (Conclusions), p. 845 repeats 75% slip in cohesionless sand at 16 degrees. Motion capture was taken to the field sites (Section 5, p. 841) and slip follows Eq. (4) (p. 841). Field classification is correct.

Abstract, p. 835 states the transition between moderate slip at 10 degrees and embedding at 17 degrees. DTM mass 436.8 kg, about 437 kg, with Earth weight 128% of the flight rover weight on Mars and flight-identical components (Section 3, pp. 836 to 837; Table I, p. 838).
